name: BDD100K
summary: 覆盖多城市、天气与时段的大规模驾驶视频数据集，提供目标检测、车道线、可行驶区域、跟踪等多任务标注，适合研究视觉动态表示和复杂道路分布泛化。
license: BDD100K license; non-commercial research conditions apply
access: Official repository and paper; follow publisher instructions for dataset access
wmNote: 视觉场景覆盖广，适合视频预训练和分布鲁棒性研究；缺少同步 LiDAR 与直接控制信号。
summaryEn: A large driving-video dataset spanning cities, weather, and time of day, with annotations for detection, lanes, drivable areas, and tracking.
wmNoteEn: Broad visual coverage supports video pretraining and robustness research. It lacks synchronized LiDAR and direct vehicle controls.
scaleZh: 10 万段驾驶视频 · 每段 40 秒 · 10 项任务
accessZh: 提供官方仓库和论文；数据访问按发布方说明办理
licenseZh: 适用 BDD100K 许可；包含非商业研究用途条件

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - bdd100k/bdd100k: Toolkit of BDD100K Dataset for Heterogeneous Multitask Learning - CVPR 2020 Oral Paper · GitHub
evidence.statement: Official toolkit explicitly links driving videos to GPS/IMU trajectory information; the retained scope is sequential driving recordings, not isolated perception images.
